Turning 65 in 2027? Your Medigap open enrollment period lasts six months and starts the month you are 65 and enrolled in Part B. During it, a Medicare Supplement insurer can't turn you down or charge you more because of your health. After it ends, most states allow health questions. We can help you plan the timing. Licensed in VA, MD, GA, TX, MI, NC, SC, AL, LA, IN and WV. Call (571) 354-0146.

We do not offer every plan available in your area. Any information we provide is limited to those plans we do offer in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
